text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Man, this pain is such a drag. And I even 
took medicine, too..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've got plans to hang out today, so I 
really hope it kicks in soon—

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
You're totally pale! You don't have to 
force a smile if you're not feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Let's go shopping another time, okay? Get 
some proper rest...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... You got me. Making you worry this 
much, I'm disqualified from being a Queen, 
aren't I...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Unable to maintain her Queen-like poise 
due to a headache, Daring Heart 
immediately chose to take a rest."
